title: Sign in
subtitle: Manage the SAB bot in your Discord server.
startFailed: Sign-in could not be started. Please try again.
access: You need the Manage Server permission in a server that has the bot.
privacy: SAB only reads your account id and the list of your servers to know which ones you manage. Your name and avatar are not stored.

errorPage.title: Sign-in did not complete
errorPage.body: Discord or SAB could not finish signing you in. You can try again.
